oneTimers: The chart's net profit is $213M — net income including redeemable non-controlling interests, which was also the figure attributable to DoorDash common stockholders this quarter (no amount was attributable to those interests in Q4).
General and administrative costs include $57M of transaction-related costs, mostly for the Deliveroo acquisition, and $29M of certain legal, tax and regulatory settlements, reserves and expenses.
otherDetail: Interest income, net, of $42M, plus $33M of other income — $75M added to profit.

segments.name: Marketplace services
segments.note: Fees from restaurants, stores and couriers on every order, plus DashPass subscriptions. DoorDash reports a single revenue stream; orders placed through it were worth $29.7B in the quarter.

takeaways.text: Marketplace GOV rose 39% to $29.7B on 903 million orders (+32%) — growth in diners and order frequency, plus a first full quarter of Deliveroo, which closed on October 2, 2025.
takeaways.title: Record order value

takeaways.text: Revenue rose 38% to $4.0B. DoorDash keeps a slice of every order as its fee, so revenue grows with the value of what is ordered; excluding Deliveroo, revenue still rose 26%.
takeaways.title: Revenue kept pace

takeaways.text: Net income attributable to shareholders rose 51% to $213M and Adjusted EBITDA rose 38% to $780M, even as depreciation climbed to $267M after the Deliveroo deal.
takeaways.title: Profit rose with scale

verdict: DoorDash grew revenue 38% to $4.0B on record order value of $29.7B in its first full quarter owning Deliveroo, and profit attributable to shareholders rose 51% to $213M.
